decisions.reason: The INA219 placement after the Schottky diodes does not change the standalone regulator, source-selection mechanism, activation condition, or powered load.

The same-message MODIFY already fully captures the power-board-to-main-board-to-sensor-board topology and the main board's local-use and forwarding connections; the INA219 placement belongs only to the monitoring Requirement.
The source modifies measurement placement and coverage on the 3.3V rail and does not change the switched 5V rail's converter, GPIO control, loads, or shutdown behavior.
Placing the INA219 downstream of the Schottky diodes does not alter the AXP2101 battery or USB input topology represented by this Requirement.
The rail-monitor placement and downstream-current coverage do not change the ESP32 BOOT or reset circuitry.
The source identifies the ESP32 as a downstream monitored load but does not change the selected ESP32 module or its breakout requirement.
The 3.3V current-monitoring topology does not change USB enumeration, programming, or the USB-C programming interface.
The source does not change I2C pull-ups, series resistors, bus speed, cable length, or signal conditioning.
The sensor board being downstream of the current monitor does not change its role of providing sensor-module connectors.
The source concerns monitoring of the 3.3V rail and does not change the LEDs' 5V supply or level-shifter requirement.
The current-monitor placement does not resolve or modify the battery connector's series, mounting type, or unresolved pinout.
The electrical rail-monitoring and interboard power-flow clarification does not change any power-board mechanical or enclosure constraint.
